verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents its own API reference: an "API Reference" tab with the full HTTP and SDK reference, plus per-endpoint resource pages such as the posts listing. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/console in the reference, runnable code examples, a public OpenAPI spec powering interactivity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Looking for the full HTTP and SDK reference? Switch to the API Reference tab in the top navigation.
